description: React component for displaying and managing a team member list with search and pagination features in Mattermost.

classes.name: MemberListTeam
classes.description: React component class for rendering team members with search and pagination.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads initial profile, team members, and team stats when component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Clears search term when component unmounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles search term changes with debounce to update the user list.

methods.name: loadComplete
methods.description: Sets loading state to false after data load completes.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of users and team members.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Sets the search term for filtering users.
